feedback_provenance: Drafted by the assisting AI from actual execution logs and training summaries; not produced automatically by the evaluator. Files archived verbatim.
adaptation_limitation: Same 30 instance seeds inform feedback and final evaluation; final results are a descriptive adaptive pilot, not an independent held-out test.
smoke_test: Separate technical run; not part of the 18-candidate pool; no prompt or parameter tuning after smoke test.
generation_protocol: 3 generations of 6 fresh-context requests; later prompts append feedback to the original base prompt.
